runtime_selection.criterion: runtime chosen on evolved prompt dev; static variants then compared with same runtime on dev, no fresh outcomes inspected
runtime_selection.post_runtime_prompt_refinement: One Shinka mutation using former dev as training; runtime unchanged.

criteria.objective: Imitate Pangram binary labels on new English documents and generator topics
criteria.interpretation: Operational point-estimate targets on a fresh grouped test, not proof of universal equivalence or true-authorship accuracy. Report uncertainty and limited group counts.

repeatability.selection: First hash per available class in each <200-token bucket; not based on correctness. Diagnostic only.

support_order_check.note: Training-only reference order sensitivity; does not change seed selection. Original fixed order used by Shinka. This is not a fresh generalization result.

reference.transfer: Source rubric and pairwise experience only; calibration target remains Pangram 4.1. Prior round2 test will be training, fresh test required.

protocol.support_rule: Five matched positive/negative Pangram pairs appended as in-context references to advisor seeds. Whole support groups excluded from search and screening; support never comes from dev or fresh test.
protocol.inference: strict single text, same core.predict settings for every stage
protocol.objective: 0.5 overall balanced accuracy +0.5 mean per-length balanced accuracy on strata with both classes; provider refusal counts as error
protocol.selection: Screen three advisor proposals and previous prompt on fixed training screen; best starts Shinka. After eight attempted generations compare previous prompt and best training candidate on reused dev. Freeze winner before fresh test. Old test is now training, no longer held out.
protocol.order_check: Before Shinka, compare normal and reversed within-pair support order on training screen. Diagnostic only; it does not change selected seed or decision objective.
protocol.termination: At most eight generations in active run, or stop when the fixed full training objective reaches its mathematical maximum 1.0. Added before any perfect result; selection and fresh test unchanged.
protocol.fresh_test_addition: Added 12 human+AI sentence mixes before any fresh teacher labels or classifier predictions; same source groups, no new source overlap. Fresh total 142 after dedup.

fine_status.former_dev_status: Now used as calibration training; it is NOT an independent final validation set. Fresh test only is independent.
